title: Care Center Training Note: Courtesy Waiver of a Late Payment Charge on an Electric Service Agreement
content:
**Customer Care Center training note: the courtesy waiver of a late payment charge under the Electric Service Agreement**

**What is the courtesy waiver?**
A late payment charge may be waived once as a courtesy. The waiver is a late-charge waiver billing credit for the full amount of that charge, posted with the late payment charge as the record it relates to. Waiving part of a charge is not offered.

**When is it available?**
All of the following must hold; a charge that does not meet these conditions is not waived and stays payable.

1. The schedule's courtesy waiver allowance is above zero.
2. The number of late-charge waiver credits posted on the account in the 12 calendar months ending on the handling date is below that allowance.
3. The window of the schedule's courtesy clean months, ending the day before the waived charge's posting date, contains no other late payment charge on the account and no returned payment.
4. The request is made no later than 60 days after the posting date of the late payment charge being waived.
5. The charge has not already been waived: each late payment charge is waived at most once.

Every condition is read from the account's charges, credits and returned payments on record.

**How is the 60-day request window counted?**
In calendar days, starting the day after the posting date of the charge. A request on the last day of the window, the 60th day, is accepted.

*Hypothetical:* a late payment charge posted on 10 March. Day 1 is 11 March and day 60 is 9 May.

| Request date | Within the window? |
|---|---|
| 9 May (day 60) | yes |
| 10 May (day 61) | no |

**What does the allowance test look like on hypothetical records?**
*Hypothetical:* a schedule whose allowance is 2. An account with one late-charge waiver credit posted in the 12 calendar months ending on the handling date meets the allowance test; an account with two such credits in that period does not. On a schedule whose allowance is zero, no courtesy waiver is available.

**Does a second waiver of the same charge ever arise?**
No. Once a late-charge waiver credit has been posted against a late payment charge, that charge is not waived again.
